title: Extending countrycode for small-island research
text: Researchers working Small Island Developing States (SIDS), Caribbean, sub-sovereign territories run two recurring frictions joining classifications onto data. first sub-sovereign disambiguation. Aruba (AW), Curaçao (CW), Sint Maarten (SX) ISO 3166-1 codes, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba share BQ. country-code packages either drop three collapse one row, silently corrupts joins. second classification. UN-DESA’s SIDS list, including sovereign associate members, broader sub-national island jurisdiction (SNIJ) literature, standard fields country-code dictionaries. Researchers tend keep side spreadsheet hand-copy onto project. islandcodes one thing: ships classification list, disambiguating codes sub-sovereign cases, helpers work alongside countrycode.

title: Extending countrycode for small-island research
text: Notice Aruba returns TRUE is_sids is_snij. UN-DESA SIDS associate member sub-national island jurisdiction within Kingdom Netherlands. Bonaire returns FALSE SIDS TRUE SNIJ: part Netherlands proper special municipality, separate jurisdiction recognised UN-DESA. package accepts country names, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, hyphenated extensions used three BES islands.
code: library(islandcodes) #>  #> Attaching package: 'islandcodes' #> The following object is masked from 'package:datasets': #>  #>     islands  is_sids(c("Aruba", "Curacao", "Bonaire", "Brazil")) #> [1]  TRUE  TRUE FALSE FALSE is_snij(c("Aruba", "Curacao", "Bonaire", "Brazil")) #> [1]  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE FALSE is_sids(c("AW", "CW", "BQ-BO", "AX", "BR")) #> [1]  TRUE  TRUE FALSE FALSE FALSE

title: Extending countrycode for small-island research
text: islandcodes imports countrycode name--code resolution long tail country names. projects already use countrycode, run first get ISO column, pass column islandcodes. pattern : countrycode standard ISO conversion, islandcodes everything fit.
code: library(countrycode)  df$iso2 <- countrycode(df$country, "country.name", "iso2c") #> Warning: Some values were not matched unambiguously: Bonaire #> To fix unmatched values, please use the `custom_match` argument. If you think the default matching rules should be improved, please file an issue at https://github.com/vincentarelbundock/countrycode/issues df$iso2  # note Bonaire collapses to NA in countrycode #> [1] "AW" "CW" NA   "SX" "BR"  # islandcodes recovers the BES cases via direct hyphenated lookup add_island_cols(df, "country",                 cols = c("iso_code", "is_sids", "is_snij")) #>        country variable iso2 iso_code is_sids is_snij #> 1        Aruba      3.5   AW       AW       1       1 #> 2      Curacao      3.1   CW       CW       1       1 #> 3      Bonaire      0.5 <NA>    BQ-BO       0       1 #> 4 Sint Maarten      1.2   SX       SX       1       1 #> 5       Brazil   1900.0   BR       BR       0       0

title: Reference Data and Helpers for Small Island States and Territories
text: countrycode excellent standard ISO 3166-1 country-code conversion problem. less reliable small-island sub-sovereign work two reasons: Sub-sovereign territories. Aruba (AW), Curaçao (CW), Sint Maarten (SX) ISO codes, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba share BQ ISO 3166-1. islandcodes ships disambiguating codes BQ-BO, BQ-SE, BQ-SA joins consistently. SIDS / SNIJ classification. UN-DESA’s SIDS list (sovereign associate members) academic SNIJ classification countrycode. Joining either onto research dataset usually means hand-copying lists PDFs. islandcodes one thing: bundles classification list, exposes predicates tidy joiner, stays way otherwise. imports countrycode country names coerced ISO codes lookup.

title: Reference list of countries and territories with small-island classifications — islands
Reference list of countries and territories with small-island classifications — islands
text: data frame 251 rows 13 columns: name Short common name (e.g. "Aruba", "Curacao", "Bonaire"). label Display label, used upstream XLSForm survey. iso_code ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, hyphenated extensions     three BES islands (BQ-BO Bonaire, BQ-SE     Sint Eustatius, BQ-SA Saba) can distinguished     within shared BQ prefix. wb_region World Bank region. wb_income_group World Bank income group. political_association Sovereign power non-independent     territories; "Independent" otherwise. is_sids 1 UN-DESA recognised Small Island Developing     State (member associate); 0 otherwise. sids_tier "Sovereign member", "Associate member",     NA applicable. is_snij 1 sub-national island jurisdiction; 0 otherwise. criterion_small 1 meets small-population/small-area     criterion; 0 otherwise. criterion_island 1 island archipelago; 0 otherwise. criterion_developing 1 classified developing; 0 otherwise. criterion_sovereign 1 sovereign state; 0 otherwise.

title: islandcodes 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN release. Bundled islands reference dataset: 250 countries territories classifications SIDS, SNIJ, World Bank region income group, political association, four small-island defining criteria. Predicates is_sids(), is_snij(), is_small_island() accept country names, ISO codes, hyphenated BES sub-codes (BQ-BO, BQ-SE, BQ-SA). island_lookup() add_island_cols() tidy joining onto research data. small_islands() shorthand filtered subsets. aruba() — .R.U.B.. (Annotated Reference -coded Border Areas): convenience wrapper around island_lookup() Aruba default. homage Edward Cheung’s .R.U.B.. (ASCS/NCS Relay Unit Breaker Assembly) Hubble Space Telescope. Source data mirrored github.com/University--Aruba/island-research-reference-data CC 4.0.
